main_text.p: qua Tusculanum suum descripsit, cellas nuncupat, & tres pariter commemorat, frigidariam, mediam, caldariam. Lucianus item in elegantissima balnei descriptione, has cellas οἴκας vocat sive oecos, nam ea voce sæpe Plinius & Vitruvius usi. Curtius edē ita usurpat pro oeco sive cella aut cubiculo Græci-zans, non insolens. Aristides rhetor pro eodem ponit in hac re, οἶκον & δ᾿ἐξαρξυλίου. Tres autem oecos etiam Lucianus commemorat. τὸν μέγαν οἶκον ἔχοντα τρεῖς κολυμβήθρας: hæc est cella frigidaria: τὸν ἠρέμα χλιαινόμενον οἶκον: hæc tepidaria cella: τὸν ἔνδον [illegible, ~8 letters] θερμὰς πυίλας: hæc cella caldaria est. Fuit vero etiam quarta cella in quibusdam balneis, quam assam Cicero in epistola ad Q. Fratrem nominat. Et in dialogo Adriani imperatoris cum Epicteto quatuor diserte nominantur: prima tepidaria unc-tuaria: secunda, sudatoria: tertia assa: quarta, frigidaria. Aliter auctor Glossarij, Assa cella, ἀτιδρωτή-ριον [?], vult esse cellam sudatoriam. Porrò χαλκεῖα illa quorum usus ad calefaciendam aquam, Latini non aena tantum aut miliaria vocarunt: sed etiam scutra. Glossarium, Scutra, χαλκίον, alibi, Scutra λέβης. extat ea vox in Plauti Persa. dixerunt Latini & cu-cumam, Græci κυκύμιον, Arrianus in Epicteto libro III. δεῖ αὐτὸν κυκύμιον ἔχειν ὅπως τὸ θερμὸν ποιήσει. Fictiles fuisse cucumas scimus ex Marcellino Empi-rico. Remansit ea vox in usu in vernacula Gallorum lingua ut aliæ infinitæ. Ad hæc vasa respiciebat philosophus, cùm scriberet in libello De spiritu, τὰς φλέβας ἔχον πόρους ἐν αἷς τὸ θερμὸν ὅ, ὥσπερ ἐν χαλκείοις θερμαίνεται τὸ αἷμα. Fallitur enim doctus ille vir, qui obscurissimum eum libellum interpretans, χαλκεῖα.

page.notes: Several Greek words are smudged or partly hidden by a stain or the scan's edge, especially the phrase after τὸν ἔνδον, the word after ἀτιδρωτή-, and parts of the Arrianus and De spiritu quotations. The ones I could not read are marked [?] or [illegible]; others are transcribed from the visible letters and may contain small accent errors. The word "tres" before "autem oecos" is also partly under a stain. The scan has no marginal notes. The catchword χαλκεῖα is printed at the lower right and is not repeated in the text.
